# Skill catalog

Every skill, command, and agent in a released plugin: 3 skills, 0 commands, and 2 agents across 3 plugins.

Skills activate on their own. Claude reads each skill's `description` and loads the skill when
your request matches it, so you don't call a skill by name. The **Trigger phrases** column is
taken from that description: phrase a request along those lines, or start from the
**Example prompt**. Commands and agents are invoked differently; see the short list under each plugin.

Each example prompt was run in Claude Code with these plugins installed. Where it didn't load the
skill, the row says so: the skill still works when Claude loads it, but its description needs
work before it triggers reliably. Mentioning the skill by name ("use the ux-writing skill to ...") works in the meantime.

To report a problem with a skill, open an issue and mention its maintainer.

## Tiers

| Tier | What it means |
| --- | --- |
| Core | Cross-cutting GAIA conventions and tooling (data staging, catalogs, provenance, evaluation). Maintained by the GAIA leads; reviewed against the full security checklist. |
| Community | A group member's own plugin for their domain, data or code (seismology, hydrology, geodesy, SAR, landslides, debris flows and so on). The author maintains it. Reviewed on entry and must pass CI. |

**Agents.** Claude delegates to an agent when the task fits; to choose one yourself, ask for it by name (for example, "use the skill-reviewer agent to ...").

- [`skill-reviewer`](../plugins/gaia-core/agents/skill-reviewer.md): Use this agent to review one plugin directory in the gaia-skills repository before it merges: security checklist, frontmatter, self-contained links, and whether the description will trigger.
